injected_work.purpose: prove the firmware HLI ISR and controller task consume a QEMU-posted work item

serial_marker: Fatal error in queue_signal: s_meta_queue full
counter_note: The hli-consumed observer remained zero because of an instrumentation comparison bug; queue depths returning to zero plus the guest serial marker are the consumption evidence.
conclusion: The firmware HLI queue and INTSET bit 29 provide a valid guest task/IRQ delivery seam. This spike injected an event-13 marker, not a controller packet, so it does not close HCI-3b or replace the VHCI backend.
next_step: Post a functional event-13 work item using a guest-allocated controller event buffer and the real ble_transport_to_hs_evt_impl callback, require Reset Complete to advance the guest, then investigate ACL buffer ownership before combining the API-boundary H2C transaction.
